scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss --skip-generate; node dist/index.js
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: npx kill-port 3001 --quiet 2>nul && cd server && npm run dev
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
